title: MemoryValue
description: A typed value of the closed memory catalog mem-0.1 (ADR-047). One type today: salary_net, the user's declared net salary from a pay month on. Unknown types and fields are refused; a boolean is not an amount. A value is what the user declared, never a credited salary.

pay_month.description: YYYY-MM: the month whose payday (last weekday) first credits the salary. It funds the next pay cycle (ADR-040).
